◈ ARC II — THE SHOW. The sky tore open a week ago and the village is still here. Still eating. The audience has noticed. Strangers will come — not because the plot says so, but because surviving is worth watching.

◈ FLASHBACK — Coat button
The last winter before the scattering. You don't talk about it. The button remembers the weight of that coat, the cold that got in anyway, and who was wearing it.
🧵 THE THREAD HOME — Seek June Jankowski — your sister, Taken at the Scattering. The Photo album still says their name.

◈ ARC III — ENGINES. SYSTEM: "VIEWERSHIP MILESTONE. Organic unit demonstrates compounding capability. Resonance protocols unlocked." — Your gifts deepen. Used in sequence, they resonate. The village is no longer just surviving. It is becoming something.

◈ RESONANCE HARMONICS — SYSTEM: "HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED. Objects with high observer-attention waveforms function as auxiliary capacitors. We call this RESONANCE HARMONICS. We do not know why the waveforms taste like grief. We have stopped asking." — Hold a keepsake. Think about the
📋 SYSTEM QUEST: "We have studied cooking. Step one: apply heat until food stops being food? No — wait. We had it. Teach us? Show us one cooked meal, start to finish."

◈ FLASHBACK — Boot stone
You carry a guilt like a stone in the boot. So you carry a stone in the boot — the scattering took the one person you were keeping alive, and this is the shape of that. It keeps you honest.

◈ SYSTEM: "51. You see the number. THE WORLD IS WATCHING. Broadcast tier: planetary — the audience has picked its favorite fire and it is YOURS. This is not the table. The table comes later. Tonight, the galaxy wants a show."

Haven couldn't hold. On the third hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.
